spec.title: TVX-SKYNET External Dependencies
spec.description: SOC view of automatically collected public provider status, current incidents, service usage and collection coverage.

spec.title: Monitored service health
spec.description: Worst reported state among public service-health feeds. Providers publishing only unscoped public information are counted separately under Coverage gaps.

spec.rawSql:
WITH reported_status AS (
 SELECT p.effective_status AS status FROM external_status.provider_current p
 JOIN external_status.sources s USING (id)
 WHERE s.collection_mode NOT IN ('manual', 'public_advisory')
    OR (NOT p.stale AND p.effective_status <> 'unknown')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT i.impact AS status FROM external_status.active_incidents i
 JOIN external_status.sources s ON s.id = i.provider_id
 WHERE s.enabled AND s.collection_mode <> 'public_advisory'
)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE status WHEN 'operational' THEN 0 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1
 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
 WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END), 2) AS "Monitored service health" FROM reported_status;

spec.title: Current incidents
spec.description: One row per unresolved provider incident, with the affected service and exact incident title. Provider outages without a published incident get an explicit summary. Limited public coverage and collector failures are shown in provider state below.

spec.rawSql:
WITH issues AS (
    SELECT
        provider.name AS "Provider",
        COALESCE(affected.names, 'Provider-wide / not specified') AS "Affected service",
        COALESCE(incident.title, 'Provider reports ' || replace(provider.effective_status, '_', ' ')) AS "Issue",
        COALESCE(incident.impact, provider.effective_status) AS "Impact",
        COALESCE(incident.lifecycle, 'provider_status') AS "Stage",
        COALESCE(incident.provider_updated_at, provider.last_success_at) AS "Updated",
        COALESCE(incident.source_url, NULLIF(catalog.status_url, '')) AS "Source"
    FROM external_status.provider_current AS provider
    JOIN external_status.sources AS catalog ON catalog.id = provider.id
    LEFT JOIN external_status.active_incidents AS incident ON incident.provider_id = provider.id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT string_agg(component.name, ', ' ORDER BY component.name) AS names
        FROM external_status.components AS component
        WHERE component.provider_id = provider.id
          AND component.active
          AND ((incident.external_id IS NOT NULL AND component.external_id = ANY(incident.affected_component_ids))
               OR (incident.external_id IS NULL AND component.current_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage', 'maintenance')))
    ) AS affected ON TRUE
    WHERE incident.external_id IS NOT NULL
       OR provider.effective_status IN ('degraded', 'partial_outage', 'major_outage', 'maintenance')
), display_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM issues
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'All providers', ''::text, 'No reported service incidents', 'operational', ''::text, NULL::timestamptz, NULL::text
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issues)
)
SELECT * FROM display_rows
ORDER BY CASE "Impact" WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3
    WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, "Provider", "Updated" DESC;

spec.title: Provider health
spec.description: Current provider condition, freshness, and last collector error.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CASE WHEN c.domain <> '' THEN 'https://www.google.com/s2/favicons?domain_url=https://' || c.domain || '&sz=64' END AS "Icon",
    p.name AS "Provider", c.dependency AS "Used for", p.effective_status AS "Status",
    CASE WHEN c.collection_mode = 'manual' AND p.last_success_at IS NULL THEN 'Awaiting report'
         WHEN c.collection_mode = 'manual' AND p.stale THEN 'Report expired'
         WHEN p.last_success_at IS NULL THEN 'Not checked'
         WHEN p.stale THEN 'Stale'
         WHEN p.consecutive_failures > 0 THEN 'Poll failing'
         WHEN c.collection_mode = 'public_advisory' THEN 'Public info only'
         ELSE 'Fresh' END AS "Collection",
    p.last_success_at AS "Last checked", COALESCE(p.last_error, CASE WHEN c.collection_mode = 'public_advisory' THEN c.coverage ELSE '' END) AS "Detail"
FROM external_status.provider_current p JOIN external_status.sources c USING (id)
ORDER BY CASE p.effective_status WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4
 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, p.name;

spec.title: Incident details and source links
spec.description: Current unresolved incidents and the latest lifecycle reported by each provider.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    source.name AS "Provider",
    incident.title AS "Incident",
    incident.lifecycle AS "Lifecycle",
    incident.impact AS "Impact",
    incident.started_at AS "Started",
    incident.provider_updated_at AS "Updated",
    incident.source_url AS "Source"
FROM external_status.active_incidents AS incident
JOIN external_status.sources AS source ON source.id = incident.provider_id
ORDER BY incident.provider_updated_at DESC;

spec.title: Automatic collection reliability
spec.description: Network/API collector success during the selected range. Manual reports are excluded. Success rates use a fixed 0–100% scale.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS "Provider", COUNT(*) AS "Checks",
 ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN a.succeeded THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) AS "Success rate",
 MAX(a.checked_at) AS "Last check"
FROM external_status.poll_attempts a JOIN external_status.sources s ON s.id = a.source_id
WHERE s.enabled AND s.collection_mode NOT IN ('manual', 'public_advisory') AND $__timeFilter(a.checked_at)
GROUP BY s.id, s.name ORDER BY "Success rate", s.name;

spec.title: Service history
spec.description: Provider observations connected between checks. Gaps beyond each source freshness threshold become Unknown; hover to read the normalized state.

spec.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
 SELECT o.provider_id, s.name, o.observed_at, s.stale_after_seconds,
  LEAD(o.observed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY o.provider_id ORDER BY o.observed_at) AS next_at,
  CASE o.status WHEN 'operational' THEN 0 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2
   WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END::double precision AS value
 FROM external_status.provider_observations o JOIN external_status.sources s ON s.id = o.provider_id
 WHERE s.enabled AND s.collection_mode <> 'public_advisory' AND s.collection_mode <> 'public_advisory' AND $__timeFilter(o.observed_at)
), states AS (
 SELECT observed_at AS "time", name AS metric, value FROM samples
 UNION ALL
 SELECT observed_at + stale_after_seconds * interval '1 second', name, 2::double precision
 FROM samples WHERE observed_at + stale_after_seconds * interval '1 second' < COALESCE(next_at, now())
)
SELECT * FROM states WHERE $__timeFilter("time") ORDER BY "time";

spec.title: Component state
spec.description: Worst state per provider/component name; duplicate regional entries are grouped with their instance count. Limited to 250 rows; select a provider for detail.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT source.name AS "Provider", component.name AS "Component",
 CASE MAX(CASE component.current_status WHEN 'operational' THEN 0 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1
  WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END)
 WHEN 0 THEN 'operational' WHEN 1 THEN 'maintenance' WHEN 2 THEN 'unknown'
 WHEN 3 THEN 'degraded' WHEN 4 THEN 'partial_outage' ELSE 'major_outage' END AS "Status",
 COUNT(*) AS "Reported instances", MAX(component.provider_updated_at) AS "Provider updated"
FROM external_status.components component JOIN external_status.sources source ON source.id = component.provider_id
WHERE source.enabled AND component.active AND component.provider_id ~ '^${provider:regex}$'
GROUP BY source.name, component.name
ORDER BY MAX(CASE component.current_status WHEN 'operational' THEN 0 WHEN 'maintenance' THEN 1
 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 WHEN 'degraded' THEN 3 WHEN 'partial_outage' THEN 4 WHEN 'major_outage' THEN 5 ELSE 2 END) DESC,
 source.name, component.name LIMIT 250;

spec.title: Recent poll attempts
spec.description: Recent successful and failed collection attempts for the selected providers.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    checked_at AS "Checked",
    source_id AS "Source",
    succeeded AS "Succeeded",
    COALESCE(error, '') AS "Error"
FROM external_status.poll_attempts
WHERE $__timeFilter(checked_at)
  AND source_id ~ '^${provider:regex}$'
ORDER BY checked_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

spec.title: Dependency coverage and status sources
spec.description: What each dependency affects, how status is collected and where coverage is incomplete. Manual and credential-dependent sources stay unknown until reporting is configured.

options.content: **Current incidents** shows provider, affected service and full incident title. Click an issue for the provider’s updates. All configured sources collect automatically. **Public info only** means the provider publishes no verified global network-health signal: page reachability is not treated as operational service. Microsoft uses public advisories and needs no tenant ID. The Provider filter applies to component and poll details.

spec.title: Coverage gaps
spec.description: Sources with unavailable health signals, stale data or failed collection. Successful public-page retrieval without a global network-health signal remains Unknown.

spec.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint AS "Coverage gaps" FROM external_status.provider_current WHERE stale OR effective_status = 'unknown' OR consecutive_failures > 0;
